The main claimed advantage of the MEMO system is lower token consumption and latency. However, in terms of correctness, it did not outperform RAG and other methods, particularly on multi-hop questions.

The MIRIX paper's evaluation methodology includes an image-based memory test using thousands of screenshots collected by students over periods up to a month. The evaluation compares screenshot analysis using models like Gemini and a visual RAG against task-based performance, and also calculates storage size.
